rate_limits: Public REST: 120 requests/minute (recommended ≤1 request/second). Private REST: 600 requests/minute (recommended ≤5 requests/second). Some endpoints have stricter documented limits.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: Corrected. Gemini’s current official rate-limit page specifies 120 requests/minute for public API entry points and 600 requests/minute for private entry points, with recommended pacing of 1 and 5 requests/second respectively. Certain endpoint pages document stricter exceptions. Evidence: https://developer.gemini.com/rate-limit
